name: Volaren Inc.
long_description:
Volaren is an agent for your portfolio that explains each move, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. 

Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose. 

Everything works from the app, the web or a simple text, so managing your money feels like texting a portfolio manager who never sleeps.

launches.title: Volaren: The AI agent that watches your portfolio and tells you what to do
launches.tagline: Volaren is the investment agent that comes to you
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Volaren is the investment agent that comes to you: it explains every move, suggests what to do next, and trades it for you. Simply connect your brokerages and bank accounts and look how you save time and stress with an always-on watchdog and executioner for your money. Try it at <https://volaren.ai>.

**The problem**

Markets move fast and in seemingly inexplicable ways, and opportunities disappear faster. Billionaires solve this problem by having family offices and teams of professionals that monitor both their existing portfolio and new opportunities closely. Most importantly, the professionals do this without prompting and come to their clients with personalized solutions. Everyone else sits there, not understanding what is going on with their portfolio, while opportunities to save on tax, reduce risk, or increase their returns go unnoticed.

**What Volaren does**

Volaren handles the entire investment pipeline for you, but leaves the opportunity for judgement in your hands. We run hedge fund style analysis to help you understand why your portfolio moved and when you should sell versus when you should buy the dip. When you decide, it’s as easy as clicking a button or texting our number, and we place the trades for you. When you have cash for a new investment opportunity, we have the infrastructure to invest in pre-made trades and strategies (or ones that we create based on your views).

It’s the experience of Instinct - text us anything and we’ll get it done, but even better. We try to learn what you want and need instead of always waiting for you to ask us that something needs to get done.

**Who we are**

We are Martin Pestana and Akshat Mittal, and we ran this exact process on the inside at Goldman Sachs and AQR. Volaren exists to give a person with real conviction and a real portfolio the leverage of a full research team.

**Our ask**

It’s simple, if you invest, try Volaren at <https://volaren.ai>. We would love your feedback, and you can reach us directly at [martin@volaren.ai](mailto:martin@volaren.ai) and [akshat@volaren.ai](mailto:akshat@volaren.ai).
